definitions.explanation: A skin injury caused by prolonged pressure on the body, typically occurring in people who are bedridden or unable to change position. A common concern in nursing care.

examples.japanese: {長期|ちょうき}{入院|にゅういん}で{床|とこ}ずれができてしまった。
examples.english: Bedsores developed from a long hospital stay.

examples.japanese: {定期的|ていきてき}に{体位|たいい}を{変|か}えることで{床|とこ}ずれの{予防|よぼう}になる。
examples.english: Regularly changing the body position helps prevent bedsores.

notes: Composed of {床|とこ} (bed) + ずれ (slipping, rubbing — from ずれる). The formal medical term is {褥瘡|じょくそう} (decubitus ulcer). Common collocations: {床|とこ}ずれを{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent bedsores), {床|とこ}ずれ{予防|よぼう} (bedsore prevention), {床|とこ}ずれ{防止|ぼうし}マット (pressure relief mat). An important concept in {介護|かいご} (caregiving) — turning bedridden patients every two hours is standard practice. In Japan's aging society, {床|とこ}ずれ prevention is a key component of both hospital and home care.
